objects.description: During [C0033](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0033), [PROMETHIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0056) used [StrongPity](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0491) to encrypt C2 communication using AES.(Citation: welivesec_strongpity)
objects.description_fa: در طول [C0033](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0033)، [PROMETHIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0056) از [StrongPity](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0491) برای رمزگذاری ارتباط C2 با استفاده از AES_0]RES_PRESERVE_0 استفاده کرد.[VE_C] (Citation: welivesec_strongpity)
